superior_tutorial.decaying_corpse.meet.1: ...Breathing. Huh. Haven't heard that in a while.
superior_tutorial.decaying_corpse.meet.2: Hands won't close. Can't hold a blade. Can't finish it myself.
superior_tutorial.decaying_corpse.meet.3: Bring me something with an edge. Something for your trouble after.
superior_tutorial.decaying_corpse.meet.5: Bench is there. Make one. Come back.
superior_tutorial.decaying_corpse.unarme: Nothing in your hands. Bench. There.
superior_tutorial.decaying_corpse.remain: Not alive. Not dead. Nothing left in it.
